hero.title: Welcome to our Minecraft project!
hero.description: More than just Minecraft — a unique space for players, built by fans who live and breathe the craft.

mission.title: Who we are
mission.description1: Built by friends in love with Minecraft — grown into three servers powered by community.
mission.description2: This project is more than a set of servers — it is a full community. We started as a small group of friends in love with Minecraft and grew into a project built around three dedicated servers. Our goal is to give players quality hosting, stable TPS, unique custom plugins, and — most importantly — a safe and friendly atmosphere to play in. We keep evolving and we listen to every piece of feedback we receive.

economy.title: Your comfort, your customization
economy.description: We built a fair and transparent in-game economy. Earn the in-game currency while you play, or support the project to unlock unique privileges, custom cosmetic items, and boosters that make you stand out and make gameplay even more enjoyable.

servers.title: 3 unique worlds — choose your path
servers.description: Pick the playstyle that fits you best. Each server is hand-tuned with custom plugins and a dedicated community.
servers.card1Desc: Vanilla survival with PvP and TNT disabled. Fair fights, balanced economy, and long-term gameplay.
servers.card2Desc: Vanilla survival with PvP and TNT enabled. Ranked matches, tournaments, and team warfare.
servers.card3Desc: Peaceful vanilla server without PvP or TNT. Focus on creativity, social play, and beautiful builds.

activities.title: Become a legend of our servers
activities.description: Our servers never sleep. Three worlds, three ways to play — and one community behind them all. Build in peace, trade your way to the top, or fight for every block: there is a place here that fits how you like to play. We keep the servers stable, the rules fair, and the atmosphere friendly — the rest of the story is yours to write.

hero.title: Contact us
hero.descriptionMobile: Our team is here to help. Pick the channel that works best for you.
hero.descriptionDesktop: Our support team is here to help. Email, Twitch, or the FAQ — whichever is easiest for you.

channels.title: How can we help?
channels.description: Send us a message, email us directly, or follow us on social — we will get back to you as soon as possible.
channels.socialDescription: Updates, tournaments, and community highlights — follow us on your favourite platform.

howToStart.title: How to Start
howToStart.step1Desc: a licensed version of Minecraft is required to play
howToStart.step2Desc: To get started, you need to register on our project website. This account is essential for accessing your personal dashboard, making purchases in our store, and syncing with the server.
howToStart.step3Desc: In Step 2, you'll log into your user dashboard. This area offers various features, including the ability to make purchases, view your order history, and manage your account settings.
howToStart.step4Desc:
Welcome to Step 2! Here's how it works: Our project features three unique servers, each with its own rules and gameplay style. You can explore them through the following links:



- LuckySurvival

- MineWars

- CalmSky



Dive in and choose the server that suits your gaming style!
howToStart.step5Desc: To begin, launch Minecraft and navigate to the Multiplayer section. Here, you can add the server's IP address, which you can find on the server's page. This will allow you to connect and start playing with others!
howToStart.step6Desc: Now that you're ready to play, it's time to register on our project website. This account will grant you access to your personal dashboard, allow you to make purchases in our store, and keep everything synced with the server. Get ready for an engaging experience with development, economy, and player interactions!
howToStart.step7Desc: Once you're registered on our project website, you'll unlock access to your personal dashboard. This account allows you to shop in our store anytime and enjoy permanent privileges with your purchases.
